source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The added ClearCachedHdrs and Close(false) calls are in Run after its final enumeration slice, before async message insertion. SetupAndRun has an earlier no-elements-or-enumerator-error branch that calls Complete(true) before dispatch. Complete resolves or rejects the promise and handles the savepoint; it does not perform that explicit cleanup pair. This narrows the existing migration-close lesson to its actual branch and timing. It is static source evidence, not a reproduced empty-database leak, a destructor claim or proof of cleanup on every error.
title: The migrator explicit old-database close runs at enumeration exhaustion rather than in Complete
